# holdings/ – public ETF holdings (no portfolio data)
* `issuer.json` – generated by `.github/workflows/issuer-holdings.yml` (`scripts/fetch-issuer-holdings.cjs`): every fund's holdings from the issuer's own daily file / fund page. `rows` = `[symbol, name, weight % of net assets]`, stocks only.
* `extra-funds.json` – extra tickers to fetch every day (the app's 19 built-in funds are always fetched). Edit on github.com or open an issue titled `ETF: SMH` (owner only) – the workflow adds it automatically.
Supported issuers: iShares (all), SPDR/SSGA, Roundhill (all), Defiance, ARK (6 funds), Direxion, First Trust, Range Funds, xETFs.
